t: Six British colonies federated by popular referendum on 1 January 1901, with Edmund Barton as first prime minister.
Its constitution blends Westminster responsible government with an American-style Senate, federalism and a High Court.
A British dominion became an independent, multicultural nation by gradual steps, ending in the Australia Act of 1986.
dyk: The plan for Canberra came from an international competition won in 1912 by the American architect Walter Burley Griffin, with drawings by his wife and partner Marion Mahony Griffin.
ev: Six colonies federate as the Commonwealth of Australia on 1 January

Australian and New Zealand troops land at Gallipoli on 25 April
Singapore falls and Japanese aircraft bomb Darwin

The Australia Act ends the remaining legal links with Britain
